scope: D81: the worklog history list never scrolls sideways; a long task note is trimmed in its card

libraries.verified: 2026-11-14 D81: HorizontalScrollBarVisibility is an attached property on ListBox, and Disabled (not Auto) is the recommended value; with it the items get the viewport width, so the card's TextTrimming can apply (query: "WPF ListBox ScrollViewer.HorizontalScrollBarVisibility Disabled constrains item width so TextTrimming works")
